title: Rooms and Furniture
summary: Learn the names of different rooms in a house. You will also learn common furniture words.

sections.p: A house has different rooms. We do different things in each room. For example, we sleep in the bedroom and we cook in the kitchen. Learning these rooms helps you talk about your home in English.

ex.mean: The room for cooking is large.

ex.en: We watch TV in the living room.
ex.mean: We sit and watch television here.

sections.p: Every room has furniture. Furniture is the things we put inside a room to make it useful. In the bedroom, we have a bed to sleep on and a wardrobe to keep our clothes safe and tidy.

ex.mean: My place to sleep feels nice.

ex.en: The clothes are in the wardrobe.
ex.mean: My shirts and pants are inside the closet.

sections.p: The living room is a place to relax with family and friends. We usually have a comfortable sofa to sit on and a small table for our coffee or books. It is a very cozy space.

ex.en: There is a table in the room.
ex.mean: A piece of furniture with four legs is here.

tip: Walk around your home and touch each piece of furniture. Say its English name out loud three times.

quiz.en: You sleep in a ___ at night.
We watch television in the ___ room.
You take a shower in the ___.
Sit on the comfortable ___ and watch TV.
